# Status

As of 27 November 2026. One page for what each product has released, what is merged on `main`, what is open and who takes the next step. Update it in the pull request that changes any of these; the task-by-task evidence stays in the plans and the [Data progress ledger](HTML-DATA-PROGRESS.md). For the open work of the moment, run `gh pr list --state open` first ([AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)).

**Current gate (27 November 2026, [ADR-016](decisions/016-slides-go-stop-gate.md)).** Before any other feature work, html-slides is measured against a `.pptx` generated by the same assistant: five fictional subjects, three runs each, defects counted first, then time and tokens. The outcome is one of *continue*, *maintain Slides alone* or *stop*. Until then **Data and Text are frozen** (defect fixes only, blind tests T20 and T22 postponed) and V1-02 to V1-07 wait. Order of work: release 0.7.3, the measurement kit, a pilot on one subject, then the campaign.

Both blind tests are release gates: the Data and Text skills join the plugin only after they pass, with the evidence attached to the release pull request ([method](blind-tests/README.md)). Both are postponed until the Slides gate gives its outcome. Decisions are indexed in [decisions/README.md](decisions/README.md).

## Stale statements

A status sentence that contradicts `main` is a defect: fix it where you find it, or tell the owner. The plans keep their original task text; their first lines say what is current, and old checkpoints sit under a **History** heading.
